interview.title: Interview Prep
interview.subtitle: Plan, practise, and review every interview in one recoverable workspace.
interview.subtitleTeacher: Guide each student from invitation to focused practice and actionable feedback.
interview.chooseStudentBody: Open a student workspace to review interview plans, practice answers, and feedback.
interview.noStudentsBody: Assigned students will appear here when their active Team membership is ready.
interview.newerChangesRemain: Earlier changes were saved; newer edits still need saving.
interview.saveError: Could not save. Your draft remains available to retry.
interview.leaveMessage: Your unsaved work is preserved in this session and will reopen when you return. Save before leaving if it must be available on another device.
interview.recovered: Recovered unsaved interview work from this session.
interview.noInterviewsBody: Create a preparation workspace when an invitation arrives, then build questions and practise without losing your notes.
interview.fieldTalkingPointsPlaceholder: Research fit, recent work, why this lab…
interview.fieldNotesPlaceholder: Agenda, evidence to mention, questions to clarify…
interview.questionsGenerateError: Could not generate questions. Your draft is still here.
interview.aiUnavailable: Connect an AI provider to use this action.
interview.aiResultDiscarded: The AI result was discarded because this interview workspace changed.
interview.questionPromptPlaceholder: What should you be ready to answer?
interview.answerNotesPlaceholder: Evidence, examples, and a concise answer structure…
interview.noQuestionsBody: Add your own questions or ask AI to tailor a set to this program and advisor.
interview.mockNeedsQuestionsBody: Your mock interview follows the order in the question bank.
interview.mockBody: Work through one question at a time. Every response is recovered locally until the workspace save is acknowledged.
interview.practiceAnswerPlaceholder: Draft or transcribe your response here…
interview.mockTurnGenerateError: Could not generate a follow-up question. Your answers are still saved locally.
interview.mockTurnNeedsAnswer: Add a practice answer before requesting a follow-up.
interview.feedbackGenerated: AI feedback is ready for review.
interview.feedbackGenerateError: Could not generate feedback. Your answers are still saved locally.
interview.noFeedbackBody: Complete a mock interview, add a reflection, or request an AI review of the saved responses.
interview.feedbackPlaceholder: What worked, and what should change next time?
interview.readinessHigh: Strong coverage. Refine concise delivery and leave room for follow-up questions.
interview.readinessMedium: The foundation is in place. Add practice answers and review the weakest areas.
interview.readinessLow: Start with the interview brief, then prepare six focused questions.
interview.actionQuestions: Prepare at least six tailored questions.
interview.actionPractice: Practise three answers out loud or in writing.
interview.actionReview: Capture one review after a mock session.
interview.actionReady: Review logistics and protect a calm buffer before the call.
